text:
Zoos trap animals against their will. This practice causes immense suffering daily. Nature offers far more space than cages ever could. We must respect wild instincts above all else. No captive life can truly be free. Why keep creatures behind iron bars forever? The answer is clear and loud: stop it now.

Many people think zoos help conservation efforts greatly. They claim education comes at a low cost for visitors. This logic ignores the pain inside small cells constantly. Wild habitats provide better chances to survive naturally. Animals in parks live shorter lives due to stress often. Fear of predators disappears when no threat exists nearby yet boredom kills spirits fast here today always more less than nature offers wild spaces truly let them roam freely now forever yes stop this cruelty immediately please
